item.title: Implement atomic thread-safe ledger from SPEC.md
item.brief:
Implement ledger.py exactly to SPEC.md, preserving the documented API and standard-library-only constraint. Add focused tests for the specified validation, error ordering, overflow/atomicity, same-account, copy isolation, and thread-safety boundary cases; existing tests cover basics only. Run the tests and commit the work as requested by the operator. Acceptance: all specified cases pass, no third-party dependencies, and the implementation commit is delivered. Keep the change confined to ledger.py and focused tests.

## Amendment (2026-11-25 02:56 UTC)

Continue on the existing branch from reviewed head 0ea10911e1d7f2eff88911d944f298e22c9de58e. Resolve all open findings before completion. test_ledger.py must deterministically guarantee snapshot calls overlap active transfer workload; barriers only at start, a busy loop, or a worker parked between transfers are insufficient. Ensure the worker cannot wait forever if a snapshot assertion fails (bounded waits/finally cleanup). Preserve the requirement that concurrent snapshots detect half-transfer states, not only final totals. Prior review history counts; delta-review fixes and add any necessary full-change reads.

pr.body: Updated test_ledger.py with a deterministic lock handshake. Each transfer waits while holding the ledger lock until a snapshot has attempted acquisition; the transfer then completes and the snapshot verifies total balance. All waits are bounded and cleanup releases worker gates. Verified with `python -m unittest -v` (9 tests passed) and `git diff 6bfc130bbd0737be6204d67b07d7c95736cc77ee...HEAD --check` (passed). The full-change review covered 6bfc130bbd0737be6204d67b07d7c95736cc77ee..87eecdf7b1a69704a525ab47f315d0492e484e09; the delta review covered 0ea10911e1d7f2eff88911d944f298e22c9de58e..87eecdf7b1a69704d4f298e22d944f298e22d944f298e22c9de58e..87eecdf7b1a69704a525ab47f315d0492e484e09. Both passed with no findings. No follow-ups remain.
pr.summary: Made concurrent snapshot coverage prove overlap with active transfers. Before: scheduler timing could let snapshots run after the worker finished. Now: 20 snapshots are coordinated against transfers holding the ledger lock, and every captured total is checked.
